patthana23.41:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.41:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na neva vipāka
patthana23.41:3.1: na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭigho na upādinnupādāniyā
